control.description-key: Composite Funding tab for a Requirement. Sticky FY picker drives a Requirement Details (rank) section, a read-only Requirement Fundings list, a Funding by Prioritizations grid, and a Funding by Requirement Details grid. Sections show/hide based on whether the Requirement has Prioritizations and/or Requirement Details. Host on a subgrid in a one-column tab; the dataset rows are ignored — the control reads the parent Requirement ID from page context and drives everything via WebAPI.
